senses.gloss: Nun, the fourteenth letter of the alphabet. It interchanges with מ q. v.; with ל, q. v.; with ר, cmp. זָרַח a. דְּנַח; שְׁנַיִם a. תְּרֵין; with י as preformative letter, cmp. יצב a. נצב.—נ frequently inserted,

in place of Dagesh forte, e. g. <cite ref="M01718"><he>מַנְדַּע</he></cite> = <cite ref="M00316"><he>מַדַּע</he></cite>; <cite ref="M01722"><he>מִנְדְּרוֹן</he></cite> = <cite ref="M00332"><he>מִדְּרוֹן</he></cite>;—
senses.label: a

senses.gloss: to avoid a hiatus, as <cite ref="A01374"><he>אִינְהוּ</he></cite>, <cite ref="N00692"><he>נִינְהוּ</he></cite> &c.—<he>ָ</he><cite ref="S00299"><he>ן</he></cite>, <he>ַ</he><cite ref="S00299"><he>ן</he></cite>, <cite ref="N00003"><he>נָא</he></cite>—afformative, e. g. <cite ref="C00563"><he>גַּזְלָן</he></cite>, <cite ref="C00564"><he>גַּזְלָנָא</he></cite>.—<cite ref="S00299"><he>ן</he></cite>, Nun emphaticum, as <he>אוֹרַיְיתִין</he> = <cite ref="A00894"><he>אוֹרַיְיתִי</he></cite>; esp. epenthetic Nun between verb and suffix, e. g. <he>בְּרָאנוּן</he>, <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 5:2">Targ. Gen. V, 2</cite>; a. fr.
senses.label: b
